 Frost Advisory is in effect Phone and internet services restored for New Hanover County Schools 
 Phone and internet services have been restored for New Hanover County Schools following an outage, according to the district. By WECT Staff Published : Nov. 16, 2026 at 8:00 AM EST | Updated : 22 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WILMINGTON, N.C. (WECT) - Phone and internet services have been restored for New Hanover County Schools following an outage, according to the district.
 During the outage, the district told staff and families that crews were working to restore service and that emergency phones had been activated.
 Families who needed immediate assistance were asked to email their school’s principal.
